title: Prove the global anchored BIT regrading bound
body:
The sharply optimal signed BIT change is zero at both trials for the original packet graph and containment directions with 229 replicated anchors. In dimension `8m` this holds for every positive integer m and every rational assignment of the internal subspaces under those inclusions, including internal arrangements that mix the copies. The exact hull forces 606 of 656 components.

## Task and overlap

This refines the earlier bounded ninth-axis and cycle screens in #7910 and #7961 `5c5df5140eb906bc25b2e446c60ecde024ba9855a` using a global price proof for the fixed graph. The port-release #7979 changes the anchors and is a distinct scope. Original source and independent checked archive lineage are recorded. The scoped task is the #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, based on `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and #7830 `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive gives exact source identities and complete assumptions.

## Validation

Extract the three-file research export archive, validate its manifest, and run `python3 -I -B verify.py`. The clean merged replay reconstructs the graph independently, checks all 24 rational quotient injections and 477 directed corner bounds at each trial, and replays a nondecomposable two-copy fixture.

## Open next questions

Rebuilt packet graphs, changed directions or different main projectors need new constraints and exact prices. Physical erasure, stock, precision and the complete advanced application remain separate premises.
